The '''Sunstar''' was an artifact of immense power located on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The Sunstar was the counterpart to the [[Shadowstone]]. It was the focus of a series of conflicts between [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] shaman of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], and [[Morag]] the [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] witch. Logray eventually gained control of both the Sunstar and the Shadowstone, combining them to form the '''Sunstar-Shadowstone''' (although it was thereafter often referred to as simply the Sunstar).

Later, Dr. [[Raygar]] attempted to steal it and use it to gain control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but this plan was thwarted by [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], and several other [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].

It later was used to destroy the [[Griagh]], although it was destroyed in the process.
